turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have until then. Owen found out about his zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first, so start with who decided that and why.
I'm waiting, Hale. Your own procedure says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and my phone never rang.
Crazy weather today, eh? Did you see the Flames game?
We're not here about the weather, and I didn't come here to talk hockey. Twenty minutes, Hale. Tell me why there's a zero on my son's record before anyone heard a word from him.
What do you do for fun?
Don't manage me, Hale. I'm writing down that you've had three chances to explain the zero and haven't. Answer me, or I walk upstairs to the principal's office right now.
